en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a harbor (Hamnen) area with a ship docked at a wooden pier in Sundsvall, Sweden. There are people walking on the pier, and classic early 20th-century European architecture is visible in the background, with hills rising behind the city. The reverse side shows international postal text, a red Swedish stamp, and handwritten address to the United States.
